facts.statement: The genus Piscivoravis was first described by Shuang Zhou, Zhonghe Zhou, and Jingmai O'Connor in 2013.
facts.quote: Piscivoravis was first named by Shuang Zhou, Zhonghe Zhou and Jingmai O'Connor in 2013

facts.statement: The type species of the genus is Piscivoravis lii.
facts.quote: the type species is Piscivoravis lii

facts.statement: Fossils of Piscivoravis are found in the Early Cretaceous Jiufotang Formation of western Liaoning Province, northeastern China.
facts.quote: known from the Early Cretaceous Jiufotang Formation (Aptian age) of western Liaoning Province, northeastern China

facts.statement: Piscivoravis lived during the Aptian age, between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Piscivoravis is classified as an extinct genus of ornithuromorph dinosaurs.
facts.quote: Piscivoravis is an extinct genus of fish-eating ornithuromorph dinosaurs
Piscivoravis is an extinct genus of fish-eating ornithuromorph dinosaurs

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis places Piscivoravis in a derived position relative to Archaeorhynchus, forming a polytomy with Jianchangornis, Patagopteryx, and more derived ornithuromorphs.
facts.quote: Phylogenetic analysis places Piscivoravis in a more derived position than Archaeorhynchus, in a polytomy with Jianchangornis, Patagopteryx, and the clade including all more derived ornithuromorphs

facts.statement: The parent group of Piscivoravis is Ornithuromorpha.
